**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Non-component export {name} from a {framework} module used in browser code of a Rivet file ({importer})
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use the framework's hooks and helpers inside the framework component (the island); pass plain values or callbacks to it as props. Constants can move to a shared `.ts` module both sides import.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
// Counter.react.tsx exports useCount (a React hook)
import { useCount } from "./Counter.react";
export function A() { return <button onClick={() => useCount()}>x</button>; }
```

```tsx prefer
// shared.ts exports START; Counter.react.tsx uses its own hooks
import { START } from "./shared";
export function A() { return <button onClick={() => console.log(START)}>x</button>; }
```

## When it is reported

Vite plugin warning (client build): a facade re-exports a framework module's non-component exports unchanged, so the import works on the server; in browser code it pulls the framework module (and runtime) into the Rivet chunk.
